// @path: src/app/ops/sign-in/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-REQUIRE-DOOR-GUARD
// The door runs before anybody is authenticated, so it cannot call
// requireOperator. That is not permission to run unguarded: it must still
// enforce the OPS_ENABLED kill switch as its first statement, or the one
// publicly reachable ops surface is reachable with the switch off.
import { doorView } from "@/lib/ops/session";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function OpsSignInPage() {
  const view = await doorView();
  return <main><h1>Sign in</h1><p>{view.stage}</p></main>;
}
